catering.name: Vinwood Caterers
catering.priceSignal: starting at $79+ tax per person, no service charges or food minimum
catering.includes: Farm-to-table menus with ingredients from Bradstreet Farm and other local sources; full bar service including craft cocktails
catering.styleFit: Specializes in farm-to-table dining with seasonal, locally sourced ingredients perfect for a rustic, outdoorsy wedding
catering.caveat: Exclusive caterer at the Barn at Bradstreet Farm; must book venue to use

catering.name: Fireside Catering
catering.includes: Custom farm-to-table menus with seasonal ingredients from Gibbet Hill Farm; full-service catering including bar with craft cocktails
catering.styleFit: Offers seasonal, elevated comfort food and family-style options fitting a boho, outdoorsy wedding vibe
catering.caveat: No published wedding pricing; must inquire for quote based on 110 guests

catering.name: RGKkitchen
catering.includes: Private chef and catering services with custom menus; potential for family-style farm-to-table meals
catering.styleFit: Offers custom, elevated comfort food suitable for a boho, outdoorsy wedding with seasonal ingredients
catering.caveat: Limited online presence with no published wedding menus; primarily serves Cape Cod and surrounding areas

florals.name: Passalongs Farm & Florist
florals.priceSignal: Bridal bouquet from $275, centerpieces from $90, full setup & delivery min $250 — 2027 prices
florals.includes: Farm-grown seasonal flowers, centerpieces, personal flowers, ceremony arches, and installations
florals.styleFit: Cottage garden, rustic, and wildflower-inspired designs using local, seasonal blooms
florals.caveat: ~2.5 hours from Methuen; may not return for strike if drive exceeds 1.5 hours

florals.name: Laura Jean Floral Design
florals.includes: Full-service wedding florals including bouquets, centerpieces, ceremony installations, and large-scale sculptural pieces
florals.styleFit: Modern-organic, editorial-style arrangements with movement and texture that align with boho and natural aesthetics
florals.caveat: No published pricing; minimum likely above $5,000

music.name: The Lion Sisters
music.includes: Sibling duo (fiddle, guitar, vocals) with tight harmonies. Blend of folk, bluegrass, Irish fiddle, vintage country, pop/rock. Offer original songs and covers. Can perform at ceremonies, cocktail hours, receptions.
music.styleFit: Perfect fit for boho, outdoorsy vibe — acoustic, folk-rooted, with indie and soulful elements. Rural NH roots align with natural wedding setting.
music.caveat: Duo (2 members), slightly below requested 3-5. No published pricing.

music.name: East Coast Soul - Stax Ensemble
music.includes: 7-10 piece ensemble with multiple lead vocalists, horn section, choreography. Performs soul, funk, pop, R&B; can also provide ceremony and cocktail hour music.
music.styleFit: Lively, soulful, and energetic band with strong indie and vintage rock influences. Ideal for an upbeat, spirited reception while offering acoustic sets for ceremony/cocktail hours.

music.name: Lindsay Straw
music.includes: Solo acoustic performance (guitar, bouzouki, vocals); can coordinate duo or trio with additional musicians. Available for ceremony, cocktail hour, dinner. Provides own sound gear.
music.styleFit: Perfect boho, outdoorsy acoustic folk fit — singer-songwriter with Celtic roots, ideal for indie folk and soul vibe.
music.caveat: Typically performs solo; duo/trio requires coordination. No published pricing.

photography.name: Mark Davidson Photography
photography.includes: Documentary photography and film services including highlight films, candid 4K clips, full-length edits, and optional second photographers.
photography.styleFit: Relaxed, emotional, documentary approach aligns perfectly with the couple's desired boho, outdoorsy vibe.
photography.caveat: Price range exceeds the $6,000 photography+videography budget but offers premium package.

photography.name: The Grahams Photography
photography.includes: Documentary-style wedding photography and Super 8 film videography; couple-based team capturing authentic, relaxed moments with a creative, anti-perfect approach.
photography.styleFit: Perfect fit for boho, outdoorsy, emotional, documentary vibe — specializes in authentic, unposed moments with film and vintage media.
photography.caveat: Pricing not listed on website; requires inquiry for full package details.

photography.name: Dampolo Photography, LLC
photography.includes: Photography and videography services offered as a team; authentic, documentary-style approach with natural prompts for relaxed couples.
photography.styleFit: Boho, outdoorsy, relaxed emotional style with documentary focus fits couple's vibe perfectly.
photography.caveat: Pricing not listed on website; may require inquiry for full package details.

venue.name: Smolak Farms
venue.priceSignal: Custom packages based on date and services
venue.includes: Antique apple orchard ceremony site, rustic barn, three-peaked tent, on-site catering through preferred vendors
venue.styleFit: Working farm with boho charm, orchard ceremonies, and tented receptions surrounded by wildflowers and string lights
venue.caveat: Requires use of preferred caterer; no in-house kitchen

venue.name: The Evermore at Peirce Farm Estate
venue.priceSignal: Packages from $8,500; details in 2026 planning guide
venue.includes: Outdoor ceremony area with arbors, climate-controlled Victorian barn and mansion, on-site catering, coordination, and accommodations
venue.styleFit: Nineteenth-century estate with boho charm, string lights, and landscaped grounds ideal for outdoor ceremonies and tented receptions
venue.caveat: Requires off-site lodging for most guests despite on-site accommodations

venue.name: Grove at Briar Barn Inn
venue.priceSignal: Starting at $9,960; peak season packages available
venue.includes: Custom post-and-beam barn, outdoor terrace, on-site restaurant catering, planning services, and guest accommodations
venue.styleFit: Rustic-chic barn with string lights and farm-meets-coastal charm, perfect for relaxed outdoor ceremonies and indoor receptions
venue.caveat: Ceremony space only seated 100 guests; larger groups require off-site options
